review.tagline: Self-hosted Python personal agent with WebUI, TUI and chat-app channels
review.summary: nanobot is a Python agent framework you run yourself and use from a browser WebUI, a terminal TUI, or chat apps such as Telegram, Discord, Slack and Email. It keeps session history and long-term memory (Dream), runs shell, web, MCP and cron tools, and supports long-running goals. It also exposes a Python SDK and an OpenAI-compatible API, and needs an external model provider or local server.
review.audience: Self-hosters wanting a personal agent in browser, terminal and chat apps
strengths: Many channels: Telegram, Discord, Slack, WeChat, Email, Mattermost, Linear, Teams, Feishu
Built-in long-term memory, cron automations and /goal long-running tasks
Works with OpenAI-compatible APIs, Ollama and vLLM, with fallback models
Installs via script, uv or pip; Python SDK and OpenAI-compatible API included
weaknesses: Supplies no model; needs a provider account or local model server
Background gateway does not restart after reboot or crash without an OS service
Interrupted subagent tasks and missed scheduled runs are not replayed after restart
Source install needs Git and Bun; native TUI wheels cover limited platforms
needs: Needs Python 3.11+, model provider or local model server
